summary: All four review findings resolved and every ruling applied; committed cc676b1. The plan is now four phases: P1 (ansible) the F1 refactor — one importable declaration per leaf including the srvk8s4 eligibility condition — plus the blast-radius limits moved into the reloads themselves; P2 (ansible) the renewal playbook, per-host independent like renew-host-certs.yml; P3 (root) the iac-scheduled-certs stages; P4 (../AnsibleSpecs) the decisions.md serialization entry the shipped diff falsifies. F3's mechanism was the planner's call per the ruling: verified against the pinned ansible-core 2.20.5 that `serial:` ends the play on the first failed one-host batch unconditionally and that max_fail_percentage cannot override it, so `serial:` is ruled out and the one-node-at-a-time guarantee lives with the restart/reload. verification.json grew to 19 criteria — V04 rewritten, V10 extended to the eligibility condition, V15 narrowed off the Prometheus claim, and V16 (coverage under failure), V17 (OpenBao peers), V18 (build-signal detector) and V19 (doctrine accuracy) added. No new close-out entries were owed; the estate observations this pass would have filed are already B1 and S1.
